summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results press release. The filing reports record quarterly revenue of RMB3,072.0 million (US$452.8 million), up 30.8% year-over-year, with AI cloud gross billings growing 82% to RMB1,327 million. The company achieved its first positive GAAP operating margin and adjusted operating profit margin of 4.0%. This is a routine quarterly earnings announcement, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event is disclosed. The filing provides no deal terms or transaction details.
